title: Manila, 4-5 February 1899
subtitle: The first battle of the Philippine War: the Eighth Army Corps against the Army of the Philippine Republic around Manila
opening_text: Evening of 4 February 1899. The Eighth Army Corps holds a line of blockhouses around Manila, with the Filipino army entrenched facing it. Press play: the first shot is fired at Santa Mesa at 20:30.

title: Luzon, 1899
subtitle: The Philippine War in central and northern Luzon, day by day: from Manila to the pursuit of Aguinaldo
opening_text: February 1899. The Eighth Army Corps holds Manila; the Philippine Republic, with its capital at Malolos, holds the rest of Luzon. Press play: the war begins at Manila on the evening of the 4th.
